draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 6.26, the 59th-best grade among 259 2021 draftees and 7th of 22 at LB. He lasted until pick 115, well after his grade rank (59th): he slid relative to the published grade. Published comparison: Tahir Whitehead. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%. College production: 58 tackles in 2020, 14th of 22 LBs in his class with stats.

current.summary: Current status: free agent. Last NFL action came in 2023. 26 career games and 0 starts over 3 completed seasons. Career-best season: 1 AV in 2021. Weak spots: combined tackles 2 (2nd percentile), approximate value 1 (14th percentile). Played 10 of 17 games in 2023.
